policies.title: About UsedRight
policies.summary: Who UsedRight is, our brand promise ("Know Exactly What You’re Buying."), and how our Nigerian pre-owned technology marketplace operates.

sections.heading: 1. Marketplace Mission & Brand Promise
paragraphs: UsedRight (shopusedright.com) is a Nigerian pre-owned technology marketplace built to bring clarity, verifiable device histories, and honest pricing to pre-owned smartphones, laptops, tablets, audio gear, cameras, and accessories.

Our core brand promise is "Know Exactly What You’re Buying." Every device listing must state exact specifications, cosmetic grade, functional status, known defects, battery condition, and foreign-origin provenance before checkout.

sections.heading: 2. Marketplace Role
paragraphs: UsedRight acts as an online marketplace platform connecting Nigerian buyers with identity-verified electronics merchants. UsedRight facilitates product discovery, transparent disclosures, order management, payment collection and reconciliation, Delivery Verification Code confirmation, and dispute review.
UsedRight does not operate its own delivery fleet at this stage; independent vendors arrange dispatch through their own riders or third-party logistics partners.

sections.heading: 3. Legal Review Notice

policies.title: Customer Terms and Conditions
policies.summary: Clear rules governing browsing, ordering, multi-vendor checkout, pricing, delivery verification, and post-purchase rights on UsedRight.

sections.heading: 1. Eligibility & Account Accuracy
paragraphs: By placing an order on UsedRight, you confirm that you are legally permitted to enter transactions in Nigeria and that your full name, valid Nigerian phone number, email address, and delivery or pickup details are accurate.

sections.heading: 2. Orders, Pricing & Multi-Vendor Fulfilment
paragraphs: When you purchase from multiple merchants in one cart, you make one consolidated payment covering a Parent Order and separate Vendor Sub-Orders. Each vendor fulfils their own items independently.

All monetary prices are stated in Nigerian Naira (₦). Before payment, UsedRight shows the product subtotal, Customer Platform Service Fee (capped at 0.7%), itemized per-vendor delivery fees, and the exact payable total.

sections.heading: 3. Delivery Verification & Inspection
paragraphs: For dispatched or pickup orders, you will receive a confidential one-time Delivery Verification Code. Never disclose this code to any dispatcher, courier, or vendor before physically receiving your package.
Confirming delivery receipt initiates the 24-hour inspection period to inspect the item against listing disclosures without waiving your statutory rights under Nigerian law.

policies.title: Vendor Agreement
policies.summary: Commercial, listing, fulfilment, delivery, warranty, fee, and compliance obligations accepted by every UsedRight vendor.

sections.heading: 1. Mandatory Onboarding & Honest Representation
paragraphs: Before listing devices or selling on UsedRight, vendors must explicitly accept all 15 onboarding declarations and this Vendor Agreement, and remain distinct from administrative identity approval.

Vendors must never list locally used (Nigeria-used) electronics as foreign-used, must not alter serials or IMEIs, and must disclose every known limitation, replacement part, SIM lock, or Wi-Fi-only status.

sections.heading: 2. Vendor-Managed Fulfilment & Fixed Delivery Rules

sections.heading: 3. Vendor Platform Service Fee & Revenue Allocation

Revenue generated from these fees may be used at UsedRight’s reasonable business discretion to cover legitimate operating expenses, including employee salaries and operational personnel wages, customer and vendor support, marketplace moderation, software engineering, hosting, infrastructure and security, payment integration operations, device verification quality control, fraud prevention, marketing, legal and accounting services, and general administration. These fees are marketplace service revenue and are not funds held in trust for customers or vendors.

policies.title: Foreign-Used Device Policy
policies.summary: Strict eligibility standards requiring genuine foreign-used origin, airway bill / manifest traceability, and clear distinction of verification types.

sections.heading: 1. Origin Standards
paragraphs: UsedRight focuses on verified foreign-used smartphones, laptops, tablets, audio devices, gaming hardware, cameras, and accessories sourced outside Nigeria (such as US, UK, EU, Canada, or Japan off-lease and carrier consignments).
Nigeria-used or privately traded local devices must never be disguised or submitted under foreign-used batches.

sections.heading: 2. Distinct Verification Processes
paragraphs: UsedRight separates verification layers so customers are never misled:
bullets: Vendor identity verification (KYC/CAC business registration checks).
Foreign-use import declaration and airway bill / consignment manifest review.
Device condition inspection report submitted per unit or grade.
IMEI, iCloud/Activation Lock, MDM, or SIM network-status checks where applicable.

sections.heading: 3. Honest Physical Inspection Labelling
paragraphs: An identity-verified vendor badge indicates merchant verification—not that UsedRight staff physically handled every unit unless explicitly logged as physically inspected with recorded evidence.

sections.heading: 2. Visual Evidence Distinction
paragraphs: Each image in a product gallery is clearly labelled as either an Actual Unit Photo taken of the specific item or a Representative Model Photo used for general reference.

sections.heading: 3. Zero Unapproved Substitutions
paragraphs: Dispatching a different model, capacity, colour, or lower cosmetic grade without prior explicit written customer approval in Transaction Chat is an unapproved substitution and qualifies for cancellation/refund.

sections.heading: 2. Immutable Order Condition Snapshots

sections.heading: 1. Qualifying Issues
paragraphs: Customers may submit evidence-backed return or refund claims for: wrong model/storage/colour/grade delivered, undisclosed hardware defects, unapproved substitutions, SIM locks not listed before purchase, missing advertised accessories, or non-delivery.
Limitations clearly disclosed in writing prior to checkout do not automatically qualify as undisclosed defects unless statutory consumer protections apply.

sections.heading: 2. Refund Accounting & Fee Proration

policies.title: Inspection and Delivery Verification Policy
policies.summary: How the confidential one-time Delivery Verification Code and 24-hour inspection period protect both customer receipt and vendor accountability.

sections.heading: 1. Confidential Delivery Verification Code
paragraphs: When a vendor marks a sub-order Dispatched or Ready for Pickup, UsedRight generates a cryptographically random, single-use, expiring Delivery Verification Code distinct from your order reference, sub-order number, payment reference, and courier tracking number.

Keep this code confidential until the package is physically in your hands. Only share it once you confirm your parcel has arrived. Giving the code confirms physical receipt—it does NOT waive your right to inspect the device or report a defect.

sections.heading: 2. Brute-Force & Override Safeguards
paragraphs: Codes are hashed on the server, restricted to the assigned vendor shipment, invalidated immediately upon successful verification, and locked after 5 failed entry attempts. Authorised UsedRight Admins may override stalled deliveries only with a logged justification.

sections.heading: 3. 24-Hour Post-Delivery Inspection Window
paragraphs: The 24-hour inspection timer starts strictly upon verified delivery/collection—never at payment, vendor acceptance, or dispatch. Customers may report problems at any time during the window (and statutory remedies remain intact beyond 24 hours).
